reasoning_steps: Identify the side length of the square ABCD.
Note that the area of the square is 16.
Conclude that the side length of the square is 4.
Understand that the equilateral triangles AKB, BLC, CMD, and DNA share the same side lengths as the square.
Calculate the area of one of these equilateral triangles.
Sum the areas of the four equilateral triangles to find the total area of KLMN.
